about: Commands files and the problems src/keybinds/commands.ts (readCommandsFile, sharedCommandIds) and python/tools/workspace_commands.py (commands_problems, shared_command_ids) must both give, word for word, with the app's keys as plugin-sdk.json app_keys has them. cases: one file each; plugins: the good files of one plugin's workspaces, in manifest order.

cases.name: a good file: two contexts, a command in each, one in any, a command with no default key, fields the format doesn't know
not an object
problems: the file is not a JSON object

cases.name: text
problems: the file is not a JSON object

cases.name: a newer format
problems: version must be 1, the format this host reads

cases.name: the version as text
problems: version must be 1, the format this host reads

cases.name: true as the version (Python's True == 1)
problems: version must be 1, the format this host reads

cases.name: no contexts list
problems: contexts must be a list

cases.name: contexts: bad id, any, twice, no label, not an object
problems: contexts[0].id "Sketch" must be 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9, _ and -, starting with a letter
contexts[1].id "any" is reserved: it means every context
contexts[3].id "model" is declared twice
contexts[4].label must be 1 to 40 characters
contexts[5] is not an object
contexts[6].id null must be 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9, _ and -, starting with a letter

cases.name: ids that end in a new line are not ids, and a command in such a context has none (Python's $ allows the new line)
problems: contexts[0].id "sketch\n" must be 1 to 32 of a-z, 0-9, _ and -, starting with a letter
commands[0].id "a.b\n" must be 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9, _, - and ., starting with a letter
commands[0].context "sketch\n" is not a declared context or "any"

cases.name: lengths count characters, not UTF-16 units: 40 astral characters are a label, 61 and 41 are too many
problems: commands[1].label must be 1 to 60 characters
commands[1].group must be text of at most 40 characters

cases.name: white space is JavaScript's: a byte-order mark alone is no label, U+001F is one character (Python's strip differs)
problems: contexts[0].label must be 1 to 40 characters

cases.name: no commands
problems: commands must be a list of 1 to 512 commands

cases.name: commands: bad id, twice, label, group, context, keys

commands.label: An arc label that runs on and on, for far more than the sixty characters

problems: commands[0].id "Sketch.Line" must be 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9, _, - and ., starting with a letter
commands[2].id "sketch.line" is declared twice
commands[3].label must be 1 to 60 characters
commands[4].group must be text of at most 40 characters
commands[5].context "drawing" is not a declared context or "any"
commands[6].keys must be a list of at most 4 keys
commands[7].keys must be a list of at most 4 keys
commands[8] is not an object

cases.name: an id that is not one never counts as declared, so "null" and "true" are not twice; a clash names it by its place
problems: commands[0].id null must be 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9, _, - and ., starting with a letter
commands[2].id true must be 1 to 64 of a-z, 0-9, _, - and ., starting with a letter
"KeyA" is the default key of both commands[0] and commands[2], whose contexts meet

cases.name: the number pad's digits and Enter never come from a press (it is read as Digit and Enter): the problem names the key to write

commands[1].keys: "Ctrl+NumpadDivide" is the app's own key (Open or close the Assistant panel)

cases.name: keys the browser or the system takes are no command's; Escape, the app's only while its own things are open, a workspace may use
problems: commands[0].keys: "Ctrl+KeyW" is kept for the browser and the system (Close the tab)
commands[0].keys: "F5" is kept for the browser and the system (Reload the page)
commands[0].keys: "Tab" is kept for the browser and the system (Move between controls)
commands[1].keys: "Ctrl+Digit3" is kept for the browser and the system (Switch tabs)
commands[1].keys: "Ctrl+Digit0" is kept for the browser and the system (Zoom the page)
commands[1].keys: "Ctrl+KeyP" is kept for the browser and the system (Print the page)
commands[1].keys: "Ctrl+Shift+KeyI" is kept for the browser and the system (Open the developer tools)
commands[2].keys: "Ctrl+Digit3" is kept for the browser and the system (Switch tabs)
commands[2].keys: "Alt+F4" is kept for the browser and the system (Close the window)
